parameters.content:
# Invoice Parser Agent — Workflow Documentation
## What this workflow does

Every time a new invoice PDF is dropped into a specific Google Drive folder, this workflow automatically:

1. Downloads the file
2. Reads the text out of the PDF
3. Uses AI to pull out the key invoice details (invoice number, sender, amount, dates)
4. Logs those details as a new row in a Google Sheet
5. Writes a short email to the billing team letting them know a new invoice came in and was logged
6. Sends that email automatically

No one has to manually open invoices, copy numbers into a spreadsheet, or remember to notify billing — it all happens within a minute of the file landing in the folder.

# Setup Guide

## Follow these steps in order to get this workflow running from scratch:

## Create/confirm the Google Drive folder
Create a folder named "Invoice Parser" (or reuse the existing one) and note its folder ID from the URL.
Update the Google Drive Trigger node's "Folder to watch" field if using a different folder.
## Connect Google Drive
Add a Google Drive OAuth2 credential ("Google Drive account") and authorize it with the account that owns the invoice folder.
This same credential is used by both the Google Drive Trigger and Download file nodes.
## Connect NVIDIA (for invoice reading)
Add an NVIDIA API credential ("NVIDIA Nemotron account") with a valid API key.
Confirm the model nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1.5 is available on your NVIDIA account/plan.
## Prepare the Google Sheet
Create (or confirm) the "Invoice Details" spreadsheet with a Sheet1 tab.
Add column headers matching exactly: Invoice Number  , Sender Name, Sender Email, Sender Address , Total Amount , Invoice Date, Due Date  (note: some intentionally include a trailing space — see Notes).
Add a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential ("Google Sheets account") and authorize it with access to this sheet.
## Connect OpenAI (for writing the email)
Add an OpenAI API credential ("OpenAI account") with a valid API key that has access to gpt-4o.
Confirm your OpenAI account supports structured JSON schema output.
## Update the email prompt's spreadsheet link
The system prompt in the Email Expert node has the spreadsheet URL hardcoded. If you change spreadsheets, update this link manually inside the node.
## Connect Gmail
Add a Gmail OAuth2 credential ("Gmail account") and authorize it with the account that should send the notification emails.
Update the "Send to" field in the Send a message node if the billing contact's email changes (currently hardcoded to one address).
## Test end-to-end
Drop a sample invoice PDF into the watched folder.
Within a minute, confirm: a new row appears in the Google Sheet, and a notification email arrives with a subject and body.
## Activate the workflow
Once testing passes, toggle the workflow to "Publish" so the trigger runs continuously.

# Credentials Required

## 1. Google Drive 
Credential Name: 	Google Drive account
Type: Google Drive OAuth [Client ID/Client Secret]
Used In:   (Google Drive Trigger), (Download file)
What You Need: A Google account with access to the "Invoice Parser" folder

## 2. NVIDIA Account
Credential Name:	NVIDIA Nemotron account
Type: NVIDIA API
Used In: NVIDIA Nemotron Chat Model
What You Need: NVIDIA API key with access to the Nemotron model

## 3. Google Sheets
Credential Name:	Google Sheets account
Type: Google Sheets OAuth [Client ID/Client Secret]
Used In: Append row in sheet
What You Need: A Google account with edit access to the "Invoice Details" spreadsheet

## 4.  OpenAI
Credential Name: OpenAI Account
Type: OpenAI API
Used In: Email Expert (Email Creator)
What You Need: OpenAI API key with access to GPT-4o and structured outputs


## 5. Gmail
Credential Name: Gmail account
Type: Gmail OAuth [Client ID/Client Secret]
Used In: Send a message
What You Need: A Gmail account authorized to send outgoing mail

# 1. Google Drive Trigger

This is the starting point. It watches one specific Google Drive folder called "Invoice Parser" and checks it every minute for new files. As soon as any new file appears, it kicks off the rest of the workflow.
### Credential used: Google Drive OAuth ("Google Drive account")

## 2. Download file

In plain terms: Once a new file is detected, this step actually pulls the file's content from Google Drive so the workflow can work with it.
### Credential used: Google Drive OAuth (same account as the trigger)

# 3. Extract from File

In plain terms: This takes the downloaded PDF and pulls the readable text out of it — turning the invoice from a PDF image/document into plain text the AI can actually read and understand.
Reads the binary data from the previous node and outputs it as $json.text

# 4. Information Extractor

In plain terms: This is where the AI reads through the invoice text and identifies the important details — who sent it, the invoice number, the total amount, and the relevant dates. Think of it as a smart form-filler that reads the document and fills in the blanks.

Technical detail:

Node type: @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.informationExtractor
Input text: {{ $json.text }} (from Extract from File)
Extracts these attributes (all marked required):
Invoice Number
Sender name
Sender Email
Sender Address
Total Amount
Invoice date (typed as date)
Due Date (typed as date)
### System prompt instructs the AI to only extract what's explicitly present, and to skip an attribute if it can't find it
### Runs on the NVIDIA Nemotron Chat Model node (connected as its language model, not as a separate step in the main data flow)

# 5. NVIDIA Nemotron Chat Model
This isn't a separate step in the flow — 
it's the AI engine plugged into the 
Information Extractor above. 
It's the model actually doing the 
reading and understanding.

### Model: nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1.5

### Credential used: NVIDIA API ("NVIDIA Nemotron account")

# 6. Append row in sheet

In plain terms: Once the AI has pulled out the invoice details, this step writes them into a Google Sheet as a new row — creating a running log of every invoice received.
### Credential used: Google Sheets OAuth ("Google Sheets account")

# 7. Email Expert (Email Creator)

In plain terms: This step drafts the notification email to the billing team. It's given the invoice details and a set of instructions (acting as "Ammar, the email expert for AI Tech") to write a short, professional email confirming the invoice was received and logged, with a link to the spreadsheet.

Technical detail:

Node type: @n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.openAi
Model: gpt-4o
Two messages sent to the model:
1. An user-role message containing the invoice fields pulled from the previous node (Invoice Number, Sender Name, Sender Email, Sender Address, Total Amount, Invoice Date, Due Date)
2. A system-role message defining the persona and task: confirm receipt, confirm it's logged in the Invoice Database, and include the direct spreadsheet link (hardcoded in the prompt)
3. Structured output enforced via JSON schema — the model is required to return a JSON object with two separate fields, subject and body, rather than one blended block of text:
json
  {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "subject": { "type": "string" },
      "body": { "type": "string" }
    },
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "required": ["subject", "body"]
  }
### Credential used: OpenAI API ("OpenAI account")

# 8. Send a message

In plain terms: The final step. This actually sends the email that was just drafted, straight to the billing contact's inbox.
### Credential used: Gmail OAuth ("Gmail account")
